title: Where to stay
summary: Vietnam’s useful beds are city hotels, beach resorts, homestays, stilt houses, hostels, and overnight boats. Pick the area before the brand.

sections.heading: Types
paragraphs: Hotels cover the cities. Resorts cover Phu Quoc, Da Nang, Nha Trang, and Mui Ne. Homestays are the right night in Tam Coc, Sapa’s valleys, Mai Chau, and parts of Hoi An.
An overnight Ha Long boat is a stay, not an activity you add after booking a hotel. Read the cabin photo carefully. A stilt house in Mai Chau usually includes dinner.

sections.heading: Price bands
paragraphs: Dorm beds are the hostel price. A simple private room in a visitor town is the next step. A well-located hotel is a clear step up. Resort villas and advertised cruise cabins sit at the top. Prices move on Tet and weekends; the band on each place page is a planning range, not a quote.

seoDescription: Hotels, homestays, resorts, and overnight boats, and which trip each one fits.
